Extract multiple Open Graph tags including type, url, and site_name

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<html><head><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"Article Title\"><meta property=\"og:type\" content=\"article\"><meta property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://example.com/article\"><meta property=\"og:site_name\" content=\"Example Site\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"An interesting article.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/article.jpg\"></head><body><article><p>Article content here.</p></article></body></html>");
  console.log(result.content);
  console.log(result.metadata.document.openGraph["title"]);
  console.log(result.metadata.document.openGraph["type"]);
  console.log(result.metadata.document.openGraph["url"]);
  console.log(result.metadata.document.openGraph["site_name"]);
}

void main();
```
